name: Holon Research Tower Fire Quarter Deck

releases.name: Holon Research Tower Fire Quarter Deck

description.text: One of the three Holon Research Tower Half Deck 1/2 packs, Fire EX, Water EX and Lightning EX, sold at Pokémon Centers from 30 September 2005 and in shops from 7 October, ahead of the Holon Research Tower expansion. Each fixed 15-card pack, half of a half deck, is led by one of Eevee's evolutions as a Pokémon-ex, here Flareon ex, and has δ Delta Species Pokémon among its cards. Two packs make a half deck.
